properties.value: All node_modules package entries in the committed npm lockfile, including transitive, development and optional declarations. Scopes describe this pre-build inventory; development/optional roles remain explicit properties. Not an installed, bundled or deployed inventory; platform selection and the dependency graph are not assessed. Licence and integrity declarations are retained, not independently verified; required notices and operating rights remain separate. Python/native/system dependencies, vulnerability status and absence of any particular dependency are not assessed.
